description: Law Enforcement Officers Killed and Assaulted (LEOKA). Returns counts of officer fatalities (feloniously killed, accidentally killed), weapon breakdowns, officer activity at time of incident, geographic region, and year-over-year trends. Period "ytd" returns year-to-date totals for the specified year; "monthly" returns data for a specific month within a year (requires the month parameter).

month.description: Month number (1–12). Required when period is "monthly".

period.description: Data period: ytd for year-to-date cumulative totals, monthly for a specific month.

year.description: Year to retrieve LEOKA data for. Required — the API does not default to a year.

name: fbi_get_leoka

deaths_by_region.description: Officer death counts by killing type then region. Keys: "Felonious", "Accidental". Values: { "South": 31, "West": 12, ... }

deaths_by_year.description: Annual officer death totals by type. Keys: "Felonious", "Accidental". Values: { "2022": 61, ... }

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `month_required`: period is "monthly" but the month parameter was not provided. `no_data`: The API returned no LEOKA data for the requested year/month. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lighting_conditions.description: Count by lighting conditions at time of incident.

month.description: The data month, when period is "monthly".

officer_activity.description: Count by what the officer was doing at the time of the incident.

totals.description: Officer fatality totals for the period.

total_incidents.description: Total incidents in which officers were killed.

weapons.description: Count of officers killed/assaulted by weapon type (e.g. Handguns, Rifles, Vehicle).

title: FBI Get LEOKA
